component.name: Desk for Jira
component.summary: A focused, native Jira workspace for GNOME

description.p: Desk for Jira brings your issues together in a fast, native GNOME application.

Choose several Jira projects and browse your own work, unassigned tasks or all issues on one customizable Kanban board. Inspect issue details, descriptions and attachments without leaving the desktop.
Jira Cloud and Jira Server/Data Center are supported. The app is read-only and stores credentials in the desktop keyring.
